text:
London gets much more rain than hot or dry cities such as Cairo (about 25 mm a year), Dubai and Riyadh (about 100 mm each), and Las Vegas (about 120 mm), and it also beats Los Angeles (about 370 mm) and Madrid (about 440 mm). The team note's answer doesn't hold: New York City gets roughly 1,250 mm a year, far more than London's ~600 mm, and Paris (~650 mm) is about the same as London, not drier. These are approximate long-term averages from memory, not checked against a live source.

CONFIDENCE: 80
